insights.title: ₹9.8L Lost to Free-Rider Promotions in Snacks
insights.description: Weekend Snack Bundle shows 62% free-rider ratio with ROI of only 1.4×, while Eid Essentials (58% free-rider) and Oil BOGO (57%) waste ₹6L combined. Total free-rider leakage: ₹9.8L this week.
insights.action: Immediately gate Eid Essentials to new-to-brand/lapsed segments (save ₹3.2L), switch Oil BOGO to bundle mechanic with Saffola+spice combo (recover ₹2.8L), and pause Weekend Snack Bundle until targeting is refined.

insights.title: Replicate Loyalty Gold Cashback Success Across Categories
insights.description: Personal Care cashback campaign delivering 3.7× ROI with only 31% free-riders and ₹17.8L net incremental revenue. Promo ROI trending up from 2.48× to 3.52× week-over-week.
insights.action: Clone cashback mechanic to Grocery & Staples high-loyalty segments (Basmati, Premium Oils) to replace wasteful BOGO offers. Target 3× minimum ROI threshold.

insights.title: ₹6.2L Margin Loss from Cost Passthrough Gaps
insights.description: India Gate Basmati 5kg cost increased 8% but shelf price unchanged, compressing margin to 12.0%. Cost passthrough gaps account for ₹6.2L in total leakage across portfolio.
insights.action: Execute immediate price review on all Grocery & Staples SKUs with cost increases >5% in last 90 days. Raise India Gate Basmati by ₹30 to restore target margin. Automate cost-to-shelf alerts.

insights.title: Sell-Through 5.2% Below Target with ₹39.9L at Risk
insights.description: Current sell-through at 69.83% vs 75% target, with ₹3.4L already lost to premature markdowns and ₹39.9L inventory at markdown risk. Margin realization declining 1.4 points.
insights.action: Halt all premature markdowns in Snacks & Biscuits. Redirect promo budget from low-ROI bundles to targeted clearance on aged inventory. Prioritize sell-through over discount depth for next 2 weeks.
